query:
WITH wealth_by_region AS (
  SELECT 
    hl.region,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN wi.wealth_level = 'Rich' THEN 1 END) AS rich_count,
    COUNT(*) AS total_count
  FROM estishraf_llm_wealth_index wi
  JOIN estishraf_llm_home_location hl ON wi.head_of_household_id = hl.id
  WHERE hl.region IS NOT NULL 
    AND TRIM(hl.region) != ''
  GROUP BY hl.region
)
SELECT 
  region AS Region,
  ROUND((rich_count * 100.0 / total_count), 2) AS rich_percentage
FROM wealth_by_region
ORDER BY rich_percentage DESC
LIMIT 1
